title: rosa glauca subvar. falcata
intro: Rosa glauca subvar. falcata, commonly known as the Prickly Rose, is a species of flowering plant in the rose family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and inflammation. The Prickly Rose contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative effects. The plant has been traditionally used to promote relaxation and reduce stress, making it a popular herbal remedy for anxiety and insomnia.
